Gerippte Bogenvase - Trendige Ästhetik Kunstdekor

https://makerworld.com/de/models/3090603-ribbed-arch-vase-trendy-aesthetic-art-decor#profileId-3482232

Elevate your space with this stunning, abstract ribbed arch vase.

 

Designed with modern minimalism in mind, this piece features a continuous textured curve that catches the light beautifully from every angle.

Whether you use the top opening to display decorative faux plants and dried pampas grass, or simply let it stand alone as a bold geometric sculpture, it instantly adds a premium aesthetic touch to any desk, shelf, or living room.

 

For the most striking visual results, I highly recommend printing this model in matte filaments or neutral pastel tones to truly make the ribbed details pop and eliminate harsh reflections.

 

📏 Dimensions:

* 125 x 150 x 125 mm
* Perfectly sized to fit smaller print beds, including the Bambu Lab A1 Mini!

 

⚙️ Print Profile & Technical Details: This model includes a highly optimized print profile designed specifically to guarantee a flawless surface finish.

* Uniform Layer Times: The profile has been carefully tuned to equalize layer times. This prevents sudden print speed variations, ensuring absolutely no banding or imperfections on the outer walls.
* Custom Modifiers: This profile utilizes specific custom modifiers essential for achieving this pristine finish. Please do not remove or alter these modifiers unless you are an advanced user familiar with custom slicing behaviors.
* Minimal Supports: Engineered to print cleanly and efficiently with barely any supports required.
Happy printing! If you like this design, please leave a boost, a like, and share your makes!

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, variable infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 3%
- Filament: PLA (#3F8E43)
